title: "Citation justification check (design-rationale papers)"

Each row maps a citing sentence in `vignettes/visStatistics.Rmd` (or
`_appendix.md`) to the verified supporting claim in the cited paper,
with page. Original test-definition papers are excluded by design.
Verification = PDF opened and the relevant passage read in this session.

|---|---|---|---|---|

| Schutzenmeister:2012 | Rmd L274 | $\operatorname{Var}(e_i)=\sigma^2(1-h_{ii})$ | hat matrix p.144; $\operatorname{Var}(\mathbf{e})=(\mathbf{I}-\mathbf{H})\sigma^2$ p.145 | yes |
| Schutzenmeister:2012 | Rmd L335 | Breusch–Pagan on raw residuals | supernormality of raw residuals, p.142 | yes |
| Cook:1982 | Rmd L274 | $\operatorname{Var}(e_i)$ formula | p.14 §2.1.2: "var($e_i$) = (1 − $v_{ii}$)$\sigma^2$" (Cook's $v_{ii}$ = $h_{ii}$) | yes |

## Notes

- **L896 (Fagerland:2012)** — clear factual mismatch: the "40–50
  observations" figure is not in the cited paper (which uses n=200).
- **L314 (Razali:2011; Yap:2011)** — the "AD highly sensitive to tail
  deviations" framing is not stated by either source; both rank AD
  second to SW (Yap, asymmetric) or merely "comparable" (Razali). The
  property is true in the wider literature but unsupported by these
  two cites.
- The earlier "Yap:2011 mislabeled PDF" note was incorrect: the bib
  `file=` field resolves to the genuine Yap & Sim (2011) paper.
